tia_compliance: Quick ask from the SOC2 auditor — they want RBAC change evidence for the service account `svc-deploy` between 2025-11-01 and 2026-02-15. Also need KMS envelope IDs for keys used and a signed export. Can someone assemble a minimal deliverable (PR, approver, rolebinding diff, audit log lines, KMS event IDs) by EOD PST? :grimacing:

devon_sre: I can pull rolebinding diffs + audit logs. Which AWS account/cluster? prod or prod-data?

tia_compliance: prod (org=redwood-prod). Auditor explicitly wants PR link, approver, the exact audit log lines with request_id and the KMS key ARN/envelopeKeyId.

anne_security: Clarify — `svc-deploy` is a pipeline service account, right? human approver will be a GitHub user. We should redact any auth tokens.

tia_compliance: yes, pipeline SA. They want proof of least-privilege and the KMS usage tied to the deployment events.

devon_sre: Ok — I'll run a targeted export. Command I used (example):
```
# filter k8s audit logs for svc-deploy and export to S3
aws logs filter-log-events \
  --log-group /aws/kubernetes/audit \
  --start-time 1700000000000 \
  --end-time 1709999999999 \
  --filter-pattern 'svc-deploy' \
  --output json > /tmp/1812345670-rbac-svc-deploy.json
# upload
aws s3 cp /tmp/1812345670-rbac-svc-deploy.json s3://redwood-evidence/iso/soc2/2026-02-exports/1812345670-rbac-svc-deploy.json
```
I will include the matching CloudTrail KMS Encrypt/Decrypt events by request ID.

evidence-bot: Export complete — s3://redwood-evidence/iso/soc2/2026-02-exports/1812345670-rbac-svc-deploy.json (sha256 attached: s3://redwood-evidence/iso/soc2/2026-02-exports/1812345670-rbac-svc-deploy.json.sha256)

mike_oncall: For KMS envelope IDs: use CloudTrail lookup for `Encrypt`/`Decrypt` events and capture `requestParameters.envelopeKeyId` and `requestID`. Example query in Athena: `SELECT eventtime, requestid, requestparameters, resources FROM cloudtrail_logs WHERE eventname='Encrypt' AND useridentity.sessioncontext.sessionissuer.userName='svc-deploy'`

jane_auditor: The sample JSON should contain: PR link, approver username, rolebinding diff (sha256 of diff ok), one or two audit log entries with `request_id`, timestamp, actor, action, and the KMS KeyArn + envelopeKeyId. A signed manifest is preferred.

anne_security: I'll assemble a small checklist and PGP-sign the manifest. Manifest template I'll upload to the same S3 folder. Template: 
```
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2345
- Approver: @alex_ops (github: alex_ops)
- Rolebinding diff: sha256: <hash>
- Audit log sample: { request_id, timestamp, actor, verb, resource }
- KMS evidence: CloudTrail event IDs, KeyArn, envelopeKeyId
- Signed manifest: 1812345670-manifest-signed.asc
```

tia_compliance: Timeline — auditor asked for deliverable by EOD PST today. Can we do it?

devon_sre: I can finish export + redact any PII by 17:00 PST. Will flag any entries that include user emails.

anne_security: I'll sign immediately after export and set object metadata `x-redwood-evidence: true` and retention tag `soc2:365`. Upload path will be `s3://redwood-evidence/iso/soc2/2026-02-exports/1812345670-manifest-signed.asc`

evidence-bot: Signed manifest uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/iso/soc2/2026-02-exports/1812345670-manifest-signed.asc

jane_auditor: Received, thank you. Quick follow-up: please include a one-paragraph note describing compensating controls around `svc-deploy` (e.g., namespace-scoped bindings, weekly attestation, key rotation cadence).

tia_compliance: Will add: "svc-deploy restricted to namespace=infra via RoleBinding, verbs limited to get/list/create on CI resources, monthly KMS key rotation, deployment attestation runs on every PR via infra CI, and alerts on unexpected RBAC modifications."

mike_oncall: Ops note: ensure CloudTrail + KMS logs retention >= 365 days per SOC2. Current retention configured to 400 days — good.

devon_sre: Export uploaded and redacted. Linking artifacts here: 
- https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-evidence/iso/soc2/2026-02-exports/1812345670-rbac-svc-deploy.json
- https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-evidence/iso/soc2/2026-02-exports/1812345670-manifest-signed.asc

anne_security: Done — manifest signed and retention tags set. PGP key fingerprint: AB12 34CD 56EF 7890 ABCD 1234 5678 9ABC DEF0

jane_auditor: All good from my side, thanks team. If auditor asks for anything else I'll reopen a thread. :thumbsup:
